### 2026-10-25 – # IT'S ALREADY WEEK TWO

**4.1h**

# IT'S ALREADY WEEK TWO
I am really surprised that I'm already working on my second ever PCB! I'm so excited to use what I learned last time and learn new things too!

Again I chose to do the guided project since I was still not completly comfortable with doing my own thing, but I was not going to just copy the desgin!

![Pasted image 20261013004957](https://halflife.hackclub-assets.com/sessions/CSRBTfO1gnf3OnVHBGadYvTR5GkJjHAY/62f51bf33d1b5ac977a142e5aa91b57c1856b72f2014beb9af229d1934e00d3e.png)

# Starting out
I began by doing the guide exactly, without much change, ( I know ironic ), but that was just so I know a little bit more of what I'm doing! I started working on the schematic, spoiler it had to changed mutliple times to fit my design.

![image](https://halflife.hackclub-assets.com/sessions/CSRBTfO1gnf3OnVHBGadYvTR5GkJjHAY/1c335cd87e501fb1bbaf85713e313c10fbd4d17738100e746d31d6fbf99a8f08.png)

# Drum Kit?
In my opinion, having a improv drumming session sounds cooler than a basic piano. So a based my copper capacitave touch pads on a drum kit.

![drum-kit-top-view-vector-illustration-2T9R98J](https://halflife.hackclub-assets.com/sessions/CSRBTfO1gnf3OnVHBGadYvTR5GkJjHAY/8ead0fe399a434e0479d58b3aabb72c3da776474dd10ea806b1f926b19125980.jpg)

# New Skills!
 I was able design  a custom footprint too today! I had to learn how to get the pads to unionoze with a shape, but I got it in the end! Really excited to continuing my flow.

![image](https://halflife.hackclub-assets.com/sessions/CSRBTfO1gnf3OnVHBGadYvTR5GkJjHAY/28c81034c990e847c6da6d6968e32f6170a00662065c32da8b9a89ef0d682bfd.png)

### 2026-10-25 – # Finally started working on the Drums!

**1.5h**

# Finally started working on the Drums!
Today I took a creative leap and began working on custom drums for my PCB! It was a lot more work than I thougnt going in.

* I started by using Kicad's image conversion to covert my image of a drum kit into a vector
* Put it into the footprint editor
* Used it as a guide to place my pads
* And finally put into into my PCB!

![image](https://halflife.hackclub-assets.com/sessions/CSRBTfO1gnf3OnVHBGadYvTR5GkJjHAY/97e8d0712f8dd7716a62410c5f05101fbe27dd23b40bfdfdaf39bf5242ad047a.png)

# Connecting everything up!
It was time to go through the pain enduring task of tracing up my board, it was like trying to untangle a knot in a rope that's been squeezed tight by superman. But I got it in the end.

* GND and Capacitave touch pads on the front

![image](https://halflife.hackclub-assets.com/sessions/CSRBTfO1gnf3OnVHBGadYvTR5GkJjHAY/29c3ab22558631fcede78ddaf65b03fc89d150b473a474a6631370fa1c312963.png)
* Everything else on the back!
![image](https://halflife.hackclub-assets.com/sessions/CSRBTfO1gnf3OnVHBGadYvTR5GkJjHAY/83ebea48ff8a03e9500678c5c30f997e67ebee88820ae2b917403455d9162fa0.png)

# PCB shape time
I decided to go for a simple rectangle with fillet edges.... That's it.... it was to make sure that I was under 100mm x 100mm.  Little underwhelming but thats okay!

# That's it for now, better get rested before my next session!
